fact: SERVICOM Presidency, with the World Bank's ESF Unit, launched the Nigeria Electronic Grievance Management platform in Abuja to receive and manage complaints and feedback on World Bank-supported projects and government institutions.

SERVICOM's acting National Coordinator says its Ministerial and Parastatal SERVICOM Units across MDAs let complaints be received, escalated, tracked and resolved across all tiers of government through the platform.
SERVICOM Presidency's National Coordinator announced that its Citizens E-Feedback portal, built into the SERVICOM website for complaints and commendations about MDA services, is now operational.

Data Science Nigeria says the Edo Citizens' Feedback System, built on a DHIS2 tracker program, lets residents report service gaps in schools, clinics and roads and has handled over 12,000 real-time reports (Edo State).
